Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3.1: Dua Dua for Leaving and Entering the House

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Dua Dua for Leaving and Entering the House
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What do you recite when you leave home for school?

1. recite the dua for leaving and entering the house to seek Allah’s protection
2. use the dua in his/her day-to-day life

2. Practise: use the dua in his/her day-to-day life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Dua Dua for Leaving and Entering the House.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you recite when you leave home for school?
2. Why do you recite the dua when leaving and entering the house?
